summary: The audit checks the 10 units, which come from IIS 198 in spring of junior year and IIS 199 in all three senior quarters, and two of the preparatory courses (EPS 194, INTNLREL 115, POLISCI 114S), which are needed to apply but add no units. Checked by hand: the policy-relevant internship before senior year, the CISAC Honors College and the honors thesis. External credit is not accepted.
